newsitem.title: USA: NEC introduces WebWay online service.
newsitem.headline: NEC introduces WebWay online service.

text.p: NEC Corp's NEC Computer Systems said Wednesday it introduced WebWay, an online service and customized site on the World Wide Web for retail customers of NEC PCs.
The company is marketing the service as "one of the easiest ways to explore and navigate the Internet."
The company said WebWay gives consumers a direct channel to receive online technical support for new Ready personal computers and NEC-specific product information.

The WebWay site uses buttons and links to access NEC's technical support service, NEC's corporate home page, daily news outlets such as CNN and Time, and other services, including software to create and post a personalized Web page.
In July Packard Bell Electronics Inc announced it and NEC had struck a deal for NEC's worldwide personal computer operations outside Japan to merge with Packard Bell.
"WebWay allows customers to communicate with us quickly," said Murali Dharan, vice president, Desktop PC Business Unit for the NEC division of Packard Bell NEC.
